transport: HTTPS JSON upstream → scheduled refresh → Pages snapshot
scope: Global active catalog shared by all visitors
timeSemantics: Snapshot fetch time; each OMM record carries its own orbital-element epoch.
freshnessSemantics: Freshness is measured from GeoGeek snapshot fetchedAt; orbital prediction quality also depends on each record EPOCH.
limit: Predicted position quality degrades as orbital elements age; this is not authoritative space-surveillance data.
